title: An Excerpt from Strixhaven: Omens of Chaos, a Magic: The Gathering Novel

entities.name: Eula Blue
entities.description: A nineteen-year-old shield mage from New Capenna who works on a cleanup crew after the Invasion and is invited to Strixhaven.

entities.name: Eula's Father
entities.description: Eula's father, a man long loyal to the Brokers who wants her to join them and who tells her to gather information at Strixhaven.

entities.name: Eula's Mother
entities.description: Eula's mother, whose side of the family once worked for the Cabaretti; she helps Eula pack for Arcavios.

entities.name: Alton
entities.description: Eula's older brother, who works with Riveteers and has his own place in a Riveteer neighborhood.

entities.name: Elias
entities.description: A member of Eula's cleanup crew who picks up fallen bricks.

entities.name: Raffine
entities.description: An ancient seer of the Obscura whom Eula would like to learn from.

entities.name: The Riveteer Foreman
entities.description: A big, barrel-chested ogre and Riveteer who leads Eula's crew and offers her an apprenticeship with his Family.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: A city-plane ruled by five Families that was devastated by the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Caldaia
entities.description: The lowest level of New Capenna, where the Riveteers hold sway and Eula's family now lives.

entities.name: Park Heights
entities.description: A neighborhood and school campus of New Capenna that fell during the Invasion.

entities.name: Mezzio
entities.description: A middle level of New Capenna where Eula grew up.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: A school of wizards on Arcavios that invites Eula to join its incoming class.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane on which Strixhaven stands.

entities.name: The Riveteers
entities.description: One of the five Families of New Capenna, who control the Caldaia and its industry and offer Eula an apprenticeship.

entities.name: The Obscura
entities.description: A Family of New Capenna known for blackmail and illusion, which Eula dreams of joining.

entities.name: The Brokers
entities.description: A Family of New Capenna whose law mages and shield mages Eula's father serves and wants her to join.

entities.name: The Cabaretti
entities.description: A Family of New Capenna that Eula's mother's relatives used to work for.

entities.name: The Five Families
entities.description: The five powerful Families of New Capenna that every citizen dreams of joining.

entities.name: The Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian attack that tore through the membrane around Capenna and brought down Park Heights.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The invaders whose attack brought Eula's hopes for an education crashing down.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Tunnels bored through reality by the Invasion, now connecting planes, with a courier service running through them.

events.summary: A building collapses on Eula's cleanup crew and she shields them with a dome of misty light.
events.quote: Eula Blue, unwilling cleanup worker and self-trained shield mage, throws her hands over her head, a dome of pale, misty light forming around them

events.summary: The foreman asks Eula whether she has thought about his offer of a Riveteer apprenticeship; she stalls, saying she is discussing it with her parents.
events.quote: "Blue," says the foreman brusquely. "You think about my offer?"

events.summary: Eula takes the shift-change whistle as her chance to run from the foreman.
events.quote: The whistle blows, signaling shift change.

events.summary: Eula reflects that the Riveteer apprenticeship could secure her family but cost her own future.
events.quote: And all she has to give up is her own future.

events.summary: Eula's father hands her a letter that has arrived for her, opened, by omenpath courier.
events.quote: "Eula," says her father, lowering the letter. "This came for you."

events.summary: Eula learns the letter is an invitation to Strixhaven on Arcavios with tuition and supplies covered and an omenpath ticket.
events.quote: "A place called Strixhaven, on a plane called Arcavios. They teach wizards there."

events.summary: Eula's father questions whether she still wants to be a Broker and she lies that she does.
Eula's father tells her to go to Strixhaven, learn everything and bring it back to New Capenna and to the Family.
events.quote: You'll learn everything they have to teach you, and everything they don't intend to teach you

events.summary: Eula's mother tells her she leaves tomorrow and they begin to pack.

relations.note: Eula is his daughter, and he plans for her to become a Broker.
relations.quote: "Eula," says her father, lowering the letter.
Her older brother has his own place in a Riveteer neighborhood

relations.note: He is a Riveteer by birth and allegiance and offers Eula an apprenticeship with the Family.
relations.quote: a Riveteer by birth and allegiance

relations.note: He has always been their man, though never offered membership.
The Caldaia is the lowest level of New Capenna.
relations.quote: the Caldaia, the lowest level of New Capenna
